newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: INDICES DOWN AMID FAIRLY HEAVY BLOCK TRADING.
newsitem.headline: INDICES DOWN AMID FAIRLY HEAVY BLOCK TRADING.

text.p: *The index of the official trading list was down 3.09 points, to 919.41 points.
*The Group A index dropped 35.54 points to 2,117.07 points.
*The Litin G index edged down 4.34 points to 1,915.92 points.
*Trading volume rose to one million litas from 630,000 litas, on the central market
*Turnover in block trades stayed steady at about 2.4 million litas.
*Lithuanian Gas shares went for 0.97 litas a share in block trades worth 540,000 litas.
*Snaige remained active in block trades, turning over about 280,000 litas.
*Hermis Bank turned over 680,000 litas in block trades.
*Vilniaus Bank shares traded at a volume of 590,000 litas in block trades.
